comments.body:
Both ETHZ and EPFL are top-notch for CS, especially in your fields of interest. ETHZ has a slight edge reputation-wise, but EPFL is equally respected in academia and industry. For FAANG ambitions, either will serve you well. Zurich is more expensive than Lausanne, but ETHZ's prestige might justify the cost. Consider the city vibe, language, and personal comfort too.

By the way, I used consum.io when I was in a similar spot, figuring out tech purchases for my studies. It's not directly related to your situation, but it could come in handy for quickly sifting through product reviews if you're setting up a new place or need tech gear. It analyzes YouTube reviews for you, pretty neat for saving time and getting the gist without the fluff.
